about.subtitle: We're building the best free color tools for the modern web — powered by OKLCH, designed for accessibility, and built with love for the design and developer community.
about.missionBody1: We believe that working with color on the web should be intuitive, accessible, and enjoyable. For too long, designers and developers have struggled with color spaces that don't match human perception — HSL's uneven lightness, RGB's device dependency, and the muddy gradients that result from interpolating in the wrong color space.
about.missionBody2: OKLCH changes all of that. It's a perceptually uniform color space that makes it easy to create accessible, consistent, and beautiful color systems. Our mission is to make OKLCH accessible to everyone — not just color scientists — by building free, well-designed tools that handle the complexity for you.
about.builtIntro: OKLCH Color Tools is a comprehensive suite of free color tools for the modern web:
about.pickerBody: Interactive OKLCH picker with live L, C, H sliders, gamut detection, and one-click CSS export
about.generatorBody: Generate accessible 50-950 OKLCH color scales from any base color
about.libraryBody: Browse 16 curated OKLCH color palettes, each an 11-step scale ready for Tailwind v4
about.convertersBody: Six bidirectional converters between OKLCH, HEX, RGB, and HSL with live gamut detection
about.previewBody: Preview your palette on real UI components with WCAG and APCA contrast scores
about.exportBody: Export design tokens as Tailwind v4 @theme blocks, CSS custom properties, or stylesheets
about.whyIntro: OKLCH is a cylindrical representation of the Oklab color space, created by Björn Ottosson in 2020. It was designed to fix the perceptual flaws of existing color spaces:
about.whyList1: Perceptual uniformity: Equal lightness values look equally bright across all hues — something HSL cannot do
about.whyList2: Predictable palettes: Even lightness steps produce visually even color scales, making 50-950 systems trivial
about.whyList3: Wide gamut: OKLCH can describe Display-P3 colors that HSL and RGB cannot reach
about.whyList4: Smooth gradients: Interpolating in OKLCH avoids the muddy midtones of RGB interpolation
about.whyList5: Accessibility: Contrast ratios are more predictable because lightness is perceptually uniform
about.whyBody: When Tailwind CSS v4 moved its entire default palette to OKLCH in January 2025, it signaled that this is the future of color on the web. We're here to help the community make that transition.
about.value1Body: All of our tools are free to use, with no accounts, no paywalls, and no usage limits. We believe good tools should be accessible to everyone.
about.value2Body: All color processing happens in your browser. Your color data never leaves your device. We don't track you, and we don't sell data.
about.value3Body: Our code is open source. We document our methods, cite our sources, and welcome contributions from the community.
about.value4Body: We design for accessibility from the start — keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and color contrast that meets WCAG standards.
about.teamBody1: OKLCH Color Tools is built and maintained by a small team of designers and developers who are passionate about color, accessibility, and the open web. We're not a big company — we're a community-driven project that exists to make the web a more colorful place.
about.teamBody2: We're always looking for feedback, bug reports, and contributions. If you'd like to get involved, we'd love to hear from you.
about.techIntro: Our tools are built with modern web technologies:
about.techList1: Astro — Static site generation with islands architecture
about.techList3: Tailwind CSS v4 — Utility-first styling with OKLCH design tokens
about.techList4: Culori — Perceptually accurate color conversion math
about.techList5: Cloudflare Pages — Global CDN with edge caching
about.techBody: The result is a fast, privacy-friendly site that works entirely in your browser — no server-side processing, no data collection, no tracking.

privacy.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when using OKLCH Color Tools.
privacy.overviewBody1: OKLCH Color Tools ("we", "our", or "us") operates oklchcolor.com, a free online color tool platform. This Privacy Policy describes how we handle information when you use our website, tools, and services (collectively, the "Service").
privacy.overviewBody2: Our Service is designed to work without requiring personal information. All color conversions, palette generation, and design token exports run entirely in your browser — your color data never leaves your device.
privacy.providedIntro: We collect information you voluntarily provide when you contact us through our contact form, email, or feedback channels. This may include:
privacy.provided1: Your name and email address (when you contact us)
privacy.provided2: The content of your messages, feedback, or bug reports
privacy.provided3: Any screenshots or color values you choose to share
privacy.autoIntro: Like most websites, we automatically collect certain technical information when you visit:
privacy.auto4: Pages visited and time spent on each page
privacy.cookiesBody: We use browser localStorage to remember your preferences (theme selection, sidebar state, cart contents). This data stays on your device and is never transmitted to our servers. We do not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising cookies.
privacy.useIntro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.use1: Provide, maintain, and improve the Service
privacy.use2: Respond to your questions, feedback, and support requests
privacy.use3: Analyze usage patterns to understand which tools are most helpful
privacy.use4: Detect, prevent, and address technical issues or abuse
privacy.useNote: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.
privacy.clientIntro: The core functionality of our Service — color picking, conversion, palette generation, and export — runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your color values, palettes, and design tokens are never sent to our servers. This means:
privacy.client1: Your color data remains on your device at all times
privacy.client2: You can use our tools with your browser in offline mode (after initial page load)
privacy.client3: We have no access to the colors you work with
privacy.serverBody: Our website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages, a static hosting platform. We do not operate traditional application servers or databases. The limited data we do collect (contact form submissions, anonymous analytics) is processed using industry-standard security measures.
privacy.thirdIntro: We use a limited number of third-party services to operate and improve the Service:
privacy.cloudflareBody: Hosting, CDN, and DDoS protection. Cloudflare may log standard server access logs (IP address, request details) as part of providing these services.
privacy.googleFontsBody: We use Geist and Geist Mono fonts served by Google Fonts. Google may collect standard technical information (IP address, browser type) when serving these fonts.
privacy.thirdNote: We do not use third-party analytics services that track individual user behavior across websites.
privacy.rightsIntro: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.rights1: Access: Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you
privacy.rights2: Correction: Request that we correct inaccurate information
privacy.rights3: Deletion: Request that we delete your personal information
privacy.rights4: Objection: Object to our processing of your information
privacy.rights5: Portability: Request your information in a portable format
privacy.rightsBody: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at privacy@oklchcolor.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacy.childrenBody: Our Service is not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.changesBody1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.
privacy.changesBody2: Significant changes will be announced on our homepage or via a notice on the Service.
privacy.contactIntro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
